title: Least-squares approximation with a check
promptMarkdown: In real $L^2(0,1)$ find the affine function nearest to $x^2$. Compute the exact squared error and verify orthogonality of the residual to both $1$ and $x$.
hintLadder: Use the orthogonality conditions to solve for two coefficients.
Prove optimality by an orthogonal decomposition, then integrate the residual square.
